catalog_metric_definitions.raw_catalog_record: One source row in artifacts/aips-landing/data/products.json. This is the metric used by commercial.catalog_snapshot.record_count and remains an audit metric even when a row is not currently public.
catalog_metric_definitions.public_projection_record: One source row remaining after the governed approved-commerce projection applies provider-specific publication controls and neutralizes blocked legacy or unverified fields. Public projection cardinality can therefore be lower than raw catalog cardinality.
catalog_metric_definitions.public_plan_record: One eligible projected row counted by generate-homepage-v2-view.mjs when it is not a request-price-only row with no public price.
catalog_metric_definitions.active_tool_family: One unique eligible product slug after provider controls and retired-platform filtering. Multiple plan rows can belong to the same tool family.
catalog_metric_definitions.rule: Do not compare raw catalog records, public projection records, public plan records and active tool families as if they were the same metric. Generated build outputs are authoritative for current public counts; raw catalog counts remain audit counts.
